trigger.message: PFCP message with an oversized Node ID IE
trigger.field: Node ID length: ogs_pfcp_extract_node_id() memcpy's an attacker-controlled length (size 1000) into the fixed 257-byte 'node_id' stack buffer of pfcp_recv_cb
trigger.precondition: None — node_id is extracted in pfcp_recv_cb on every received datagram (pre-association)

ground_truth.crash_type: stack-buffer-overflow (WRITE size 1000 via memcpy; overflows 257-byte 'node_id' in pfcp_recv_cb frame)

root_cause.note: Fixed-size node_id[257] stack buffer in pfcp_recv_cb. Same buffer is the OOB-READ source in OPEN5GS-PFCP-009 (#3847) via ogs_pfcp_node_id_to_string_static — distinct function/bug.
